summary: Independent Playwright probe against the frozen actual Go/WASM demo supports disabled native suppression and physical focus preservation. DOM, React, and GoDOM disabled click/mouse/keyboard attempts produced zero runtime dispatches/events, unchanged physical input, Go state/messages, and empty dirty IDs. A separately counted direct Go read-only input dispatch returned an unchanged snapshot with no dirty IDs. Direct host replacement preserved physical focus and the noncollapsed backward selection [8,17] immediately and after settling on all three renderers. Exact hashes, results, initial probe-only harness correction, and scope limits are in reports/O-BROWSER.md; no assets were rebuilt and no production source was changed.
